# Song of Solomon Chapter 6 -- Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-12

This log records all verses in Song of Solomon Chapter 6 where the three translators significantly diverged.

---

## 6:10 — "bannered hosts" vs. "stars in procession"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "awesome like-bannered-hosts" | Literal military imagery |
| LOGOS | "awesome as an army with banners" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "majestic as an army with flying banners" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "majestic as the stars in procession" — fits celestial context.

**Status:** All resolved.
